value.title: SIP mandate registration
value.purpose: The bank mandate the monthly SIPs debit against: type, limit, approval in the UPI app or at the bank, and its states. Once, before the first SIP. In v0.1 this was one row on E02.
ui: Your monthly SIPs debit against this mandate. Nothing is debited until an SIP runs on its date.
Rs 50,000; your planned SIPs on this rail total Rs 26,000
On each SIP date, from month 8
UPI autopay: approve in your UPI app now
e-NACH: approve with net banking or your debit card; the bank confirms later
I will tell you the moment it turns active. The SIPs are set up right after.
Set up the SIPs (opens once the mandate is active)

logic: Mandate registration (Kajal, 16 Sep 2026): the SIP mandate was one row on E02 with no flow and no states; this screen is the registration itself, between the one-time setup (E02) and the SIPs (E11).
Approve the mandate is an in-place action: it opens the UPI app for UPI autopay or the bank's authorisation page for e-NACH; the Status row updates from the rail's mandate webhook, never from a tap.
The limit sits above the planned SIPs on this rail with headroom for step-ups (spec v0.1 E02); the gold ETF SIP runs on the broker rail (E04) and is not counted.
This mandate is separate from the subscription mandate on P04: two approvals, each named for what it pays.
to be verified: the amount limits and the maximum tenure for UPI autopay and e-NACH on BSE StAR MF.
to be verified: e-NACH approval time at the banks, and whether a limit change amends the mandate or registers a new one.
states: Not started: Approve the mandate is the only action; the SIPs link is disabled
Pending bank approval: setup completes on E02; the SIPs wait; the user is told when it turns active
Active: the SIPs link opens E11; E08 shows the mandate as active
Rejected or expired: the reason from the rail and Approve the mandate again
dev: Mandate registration and status through the same rail API layer as E02 (dev call); webhook per mandate event, reconciled nightly with E08.

value.title: Set up monthly SIPs
value.purpose: The plan's SIPs registered on the rail against the mandate in one confirmation: fund, amount, date, start month, step-up. The gold ETF SIP goes through the broker on E04. In v0.1 this sat inside E03.
ui: Rs 26,000 a month across three funds, debited against your mandate on the 5th. Confirm once and I register them on BSE StAR MF.
Gold ETF SIP Rs 3,000 runs through your broker on smallcase, not this mandate
Set up the gold ETF SIP via smallcase
Mandate not active yet? Approve it first
Each SIP shows on the calendar once the rail confirms it. I mark it done when the first debit lands.

fields: sips[]: scheme, amount, sip_date, start_month, step_up
logic: SIP setup (Kajal, 16 Sep 2026): in v0.1 the SIPs were a case of the order screen (E03) drawn for a lumpsum; this screen registers every SIP from the action plan against the mandate (E10) in one confirmation.
Funds, amounts and the start month come from the action plan (G13) and are not edited here; the SIP date and the yearly step-up are.
Registration waits for an active mandate: until then Confirm and register is disabled and the mandate link opens E10.
Each SIP registers on BSE StAR MF against the mandate; the calendar on E08 fills from the rail's confirmation, never from the tap (spec v0.1 E06).
The gold ETF SIP is on the broker rail (E04) and does not use this mandate.
to be verified: the earliest SIP start date after mandate approval on BSE StAR MF.
states: Mandate not active: Confirm and register disabled; the mandate link opens E10
Registration rejected: the reason from the rail and retry per SIP
Start month already passed: the first debit moves to the next SIP date
dev: One registration call per SIP through the rail API layer (dev call); webhook per SIP event; E08 reconciles nightly.
